# Forcemanager

ForceManager is a mobile-first CRM designed to enhance sales team productivity by providing real-time insights and streamlined management of customer interactions.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/forcemanager/.

## Actions

- **Delete Activity**: Delete an existing activity by ID.
- **Delete Company**: Delete a company by its ForceManager ID.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete an existing contact by ID.
- **Delete Master Data Value**: Delete a master-data value (Z_ table) by ID using ForceManager REST API.
- **Delete Sales Order**: Delete a sales order by ID using ForceManager REST API.
- **Delete Sales Order Line**: Delete a sales order line by ID using ForceManager REST API.
- **Delete View**: Delete a saved view by ID.
- **Get Activity**: Get a single activity by ID.
- **Get Company**: Get a single company by ID.
- **Get Internal ID**: Retrieve ForceManager internal IDs mapping for a given externalId and entity type.
- **Get Product**: Get a single product by ID.
- **Get Sales Order Line**: Get a single sales order line by ID.
- **Get User**: Get a single user by ID.
- **Get View**: Get a single view by ID.
- **List Views**: List saved view filters.
- **Update Activity**: Update an existing activity by ID.
- **Update Company**: Update Company
- **Update Product**: Update a product by ID in ForceManager.
- **Update Sales Order**: Update Sales Order
- **Update Sales Order Line**: Update sales order line by ID.
